paragraphs: The XF 4.2 V8 uses the AJ34 — a 4.2-litre naturally aspirated V8 petrol engine. It was fitted from 2007 until approximately 2011 across the X250 generation, before being superseded by the 5.0-litre AJ133 V8. The XF 4.2 V8 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ34 engines for every XF 4.2 V8 on the road.
